import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

def task_func(P, T):
    P = np.asarray(P)
    T = np.asarray(T)

    if P.ndim != 2 or T.ndim != 3:
        raise ValueError("P must be a 2D matrix and T must be a 3D tensor.")

    if P.shape[1] != T.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Incompatible shapes for multiplication: P.shape={P.shape}, T.shape={T.shape}"
        )

    result = np.tensordot(P, T, axes=([1], [0]))
    flattened = result.reshape(result.shape[0], -1)

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    normalized = scaler.fit_transform(flattened)

    columns = [f"feature_{i}" for i in range(normalized.shape[1])]
    return pd.DataFrame(normalized, columns=columns)
